messages:
alex: Heads-up: nightly eval flagged a sharp drop in exact-match for QA promptset on redwood-7b int8 calibration profile — ~12% error vs baseline. attaching quick notes.
ci-bot: nightly-eval #1845009: model=redwood-7b profile=int8-new-calib EM:-12.3% BLEU:-3.1% failures=42 link=<ci/job/1845>
maya: did we roll a new kernel or quant table overnight?
jon: no infra changes AFAIK. ops deploys were empty. @eva any model packaging changes?
eva: I pushed a new calibration set for 7b yesterday (more diversified prompts). It changed calib stats. Reverting now to previous set to run quick smoke.
alex: ok queued. can you run eval w/ fp8-profile too? want to see diff. also paste a couple of bad gens.
ci-bot: rerun started: /evals/1845010 (configs: int8-old-calib, int8-new-calib, fp8-compat). ETA ~18m.
maya: sharing two failures:
1) hallucinated date in timeline Q/A — int8-new-calib
2) truncation mid-answer leading to doc omission — int8-new-calib
jon: can you paste logits/checksum snippet? suspect bias shift in logit scale after calibrations.
alex: ```
logits_sample:
old_calib_mean_scale=0.87
new_calib_mean_scale=0.72
sample_token_deltas=[0.03, -0.12, -0.09, ...]
```
eva: confirmed scale drop. calibration pipeline applied per-layer rescale, but I missed global temperature normalization. patch incoming.
ci-bot: rerun done: summary: int8-old-calib EM:-0.5% vs baseline; int8-new-calib EM:-11.9%; fp8 EM:-1.2%. Artifacts: <ci/artifacts/1845010>
alex: great — new-calib is the cause. plan: revert new-calib for nightly and run full regression. @maya can you open a PR to add a unit check on global norm?
maya: :thumbsup: will open PR, adding a quick sanity check and an eval gating flag.
jon: also log this in postmortems board. we should add a small test that compares token-scale distributions between calibs.
alex: thanks team. closing for now but keep an eye on fp8 runs tomorrow.
